gold_sql:
WITH origin AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.376642 45.350384)',4326) AS pt
),
nearby_tiles AS (
  SELECT d.rast
  FROM public.dem_us d, origin o
  WHERE d.rast && ST_Expand(o.pt, 1.0)
),
masked AS (
	  SELECT ST_MapAlgebra(
	           rast,
	           1,
	           '32BF'::text,
	           'CASE WHEN [rast.val] > 2000 THEN [rast.val] ELSE NULL END'::text,
	           NULL::double precision
	         ) AS rast
  FROM nearby_tiles
),
qualifying_pixels AS (
  SELECT (pp).geom AS geom
  FROM masked
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL ST_PixelAsCentroids(rast, 1, TRUE) AS pp
)
SELECT MIN(ST_Distance(p.geom::geography, o.pt::geography)) AS distance_m
FROM qualifying_pixels p, origin o;

WITH park_geom AS (
  SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.376642 45.350384)'), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
raster_values AS (
  SELECT
    (ST_DumpAsPolygons(rast, 1, TRUE)).geom AS contour_geom,
    (ST_DumpAsPolygons(rast, 1, TRUE)).val AS elevation
  FROM public.dem_us
  WHERE ST_Intersects(rast, (SELECT geom FROM park_geom))
),
contour_2000 AS (
  SELECT ST_Buffer(ST_Union(contour_geom), 0) AS geom
  FROM raster_values
  WHERE elevation > 2000
),
nearest_distance AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Distance(
      (SELECT geom FROM park_geom),
      (SELECT geom FROM contour_2000)
    ) AS distance_meters
)
SELECT ROUND(distance_meters) AS distance_to_elevation_meters
FROM nearest_distance;
